title: Integrate audit history into IntelPanel
description:
Modify `dashboard/frontend/components/editor/IntelPanel.tsx` to wire all Phase 1 utilities and Phase 2 components into the existing Findings tab.

Imports to add:
- `useAuditHistory` from `./use-audit-history` (Task 3)
- `formatRelativeTime`, `getPersistentIssues` from `./audit-history-utils` (Tasks 1, 2)
- `VerdictDot` from `./VerdictDot` (Task 6)
- `RunHeader` from `./RunHeader` (Task 7)
- `ComparisonHeader` from `./ComparisonHeader` (Task 7)
- `ComparisonView` from `./ComparisonView` (Task 8)

**Hook wiring:**
Call `useAuditHistory(recentAudits)` at the top of the Findings tab render path. Destructure `selectedRunIndex`, `compareIndices`, `selectRun`, `addCompareIndex`, `clearSelection`, `clearComparison`, `selectedAudit`, `isComparing`.

**Verdict dots replacement:**
Replace existing `<span className="fv-verdict-dot">` elements with `<VerdictDot>` components. For each audit in `recentAudits`, render a VerdictDot with:
- `status={audit.status}`, `selected={selectedRunIndex === i}`, `compareSelected={compareIndices?.includes(i)}`, `isLatest={i === 0}`
- `onClick={() => selectRun(i)}`, `onShiftClick={() => addCompareIndex(i)}`
- `tooltip={formatRelativeTime(audit.ranAt)}`

Wrap the dots in a container with `role="toolbar"`, `aria-label="Audit history"`, `aria-orientation="horizontal"`. Implement roving tabindex: track `focusedDotIndex` in local state. Only the focused dot gets `tabIndex={0}`, others get `tabIndex={-1}`. Arrow Left/Right move focus, wrapping at boundaries. Enter/Space activate the focused dot.

**Persistent issue count:**
When viewing latest (selectedRunIndex === 0) and recentAudits.length >= 2, compute `persistentIssues = getPersistentIssues(recentAudits[0], recentAudits[1])`. If persistentIssues.size > 0, display count in verdict summary area using `--color-amber`.

**Run header:**
Render `<RunHeader>` between verdict strip and findings list when `selectedRunIndex !== 0 && !isComparing`. Pass `relativeTime={formatRelativeTime(selectedAudit.ranAt)}` and `onBackToLatest={() => selectRun(0)}`.

**Comparison mode:**
When `isComparing`, render `<ComparisonHeader>` with both audits' timestamps and issue counts. Below it, render `<ComparisonView>` with the two selected audits and `onExit={clearComparison}`. Hide the normal findings list.

**Findings list modification:**
When not comparing, pass `recentAudits[selectedRunIndex]` to `buildFindings` instead of always `recentAudits[0]`. The previous audit for delta is `recentAudits[selectedRunIndex + 1]` (may be undefined). Apply `fvFadeIn` animation class to the findings list container on content swap.

**Persistent badge on finding rows:**
In the normal findings list, for each finding check if its issueKey is in the `persistentIssues` set. If so, append a "persistent" badge: `--font-sans`, 11px, weight 500, `--color-amber` text on `rgba(240, 178, 50, 0.12)` background. Only show on latest view (selectedRunIndex === 0).

**Sizing card:**
Update the existing sizing card to show `selectedAudit.sizing` instead of always latest. In comparison mode, if both audits have sizing and they differ, show both sizing cards stacked. If identical, show one.

**Keyboard navigation:**
Add a keydown handler on the Findings tab container:
- Escape: if `isComparing`, call `clearComparison`. Else if `selectedRunIndex !== 0`, call `clearSelection`. Else no-op.

**Edge states:**
- 0 audits: render no dots, no findings. Show "No audit results yet" centered in `--font-sans`, 12px, `--color-text-tertiary`.
- 1 audit: single dot at full opacity, shift-click is a no-op (handled by hook). No persistent badge.
- Error state: if recentAudits query fails, show "Failed to load audit history" in `--color-red` with "Retry" link in `--color-accent`. Hide verdict strip.

**Index clamping:**
Defensive check: `const safeIndex = Math.min(selectedRunIndex, recentAudits.length - 1)` before any recentAudits access.
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] Clicking a non-latest verdict dot loads that run's findings in the panel
- [test] Shift-clicking two dots shows ComparisonView with Removed/Unchanged/Added sections
- [test] ComparisonHeader shows issue count delta between two selected runs
- [test] Escape exits comparison mode first, then deselects run (two-level)
- [test] Persistent issue count displayed in verdict summary when > 0
- [test] Persistent badge appears on finding rows matching previous run by issueKey
- [test] Sizing card updates to show selected run's sizing data
- [test] 0-audit state shows 'No audit results yet' with no dots rendered
- [test] 1-audit state renders single dot, shift-click is no-op
- [test] Arrow Left/Right navigates between dots using roving tabindex
- [test] Verdict strip has role=toolbar and aria-label='Audit history'
- [test] formatRelativeTime output shown as tooltip on each dot
- [test] RunHeader appears when viewing non-latest run with correct timestamp
- [manual] Selected dot has a visible 2px ring
